content: शातनम् .²1 Whetting, sharpening. .²2 Cutting down, destroyer; as in पर्वतपक्षशातनम् <ls>R. 3. 42</ls>. .²3 Causing to fall or perish. .²4 Causing to decay or wither. .²5 Becoming thin or small, thinness. .²6 Withering, decaying; वसन्ते सर्वशस्यानां जायते पत्रशातनम् <ls>Adhikaraṇamālā.</ls> .²7 Polishing, planing.
